name: Duarte Fernandes
bio: Fernandes can reach Siam only if the junk captains can sail. The embassy follows the captains’ bargain rather than creating their sailing window.
notes: fact: The Commentaries sends Fernandes to Siam aboard a departing Chinese junk (Birch III, pp. 113–115, 152–155)
gameplay: His recurring departure referrals are invented (people-factions.md §§2–3; monsoon-calendar.md §6)
